summaries.name: Luna
summaries.summary: Luna is the user's cat. The user has been making changes to Luna's environment for her safety and well-being, and describes her as a sweetie who is adjusting well to the changes.

summaries.name: Purina Pro Plan Veterinary Diets FortiFlora Canine & Feline Probiotic Supplement
summaries.summary: Purina Pro Plan Veterinary Diets FortiFlora Canine & Feline Probiotic Supplement is a popular, veterinarian-recommended cat probiotic containing a unique strain of Enterococcus faecium, available in powder form with a high CFU count.

summaries.name: Jarrow Formulas Pet Dophilus
summaries.summary: Jarrow Formulas Pet Dophilus is a cat probiotic supplement containing multiple strains of probiotics, including Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium, with a high CFU count, available in powder or capsule form.

summaries.name: Dr. Ohhira's Probiotics for Cats
summaries.summary: Dr. Ohhira's Probiotics for Cats contains 12 strains of probiotics with a high CFU count, available in powder form, and is free of additives and preservatives.

summaries.name: Renew Life Ultimate Probiotics for Cats
summaries.summary: Renew Life Ultimate Probiotics for Cats contains 12 strains of probiotics with a high CFU count, available in powder or capsule form, and is free of gluten and soy.

summaries.name: Nutramax Proviable-DC for Cats
summaries.summary: Nutramax Proviable-DC for Cats contains multiple strains of probiotics with a high CFU count, available in powder or capsule form, and is designed to support digestive health and immune function.

summaries.name: Arm & Hammer Super Scoop Cat Litter
summaries.summary: Arm & Hammer Super Scoop Cat Litter is a popular, affordable clumping clay litter that forms tight clumps for easy scooping, is 99.9% dust-free, and has a low tracking rate.

summaries.name: Clay Cat Litter by Dr. Elsey's
summaries.summary: Clay Cat Litter by Dr. Elsey's is a clumping clay litter that is 99.9% dust-free, forms hard, tight clumps that are easy to scoop, and is hypoallergenic and gentle on paws.

summaries.name: Silica Gel Cat Litter by Pretty Litter
summaries.summary: Silica Gel Cat Litter by Pretty Litter is made from natural silica gel, is 99.9% dust-free, highly absorbent, odor-free, and forms a hard, dry clump that's easy to scoop.

summaries.name: Pure & Natural Silica Gel Cat Litter
summaries.summary: Pure & Natural Silica Gel Cat Litter is made from natural, non-toxic silica gel, is 99.9% dust-free, highly absorbent, odor-free, and forms a hard, dry clump that's easy to scoop.

summaries.name: World's Best Cat Litter
summaries.summary: World's Best Cat Litter is made from 100% natural and renewable resources like corn, wheat, and potato. It's 99.9% dust-free, forms tight clumps, and is biodegradable.

summaries.name: Swheat Scoop Natural Cat Litter
summaries.summary: Swheat Scoop Natural Cat Litter is made from whole kernel corn, is 99.9% dust-free, biodegradable, non-toxic, and forms tight clumps that are easy to scoop.
